zh: 斯威本科技大学是一所位于澳洲维多利亚州墨尔本市的公立综合大学，也是澳大利亚大学之中唯一被欧洲创新大学联合会 邀请的成员，亦是澳洲今日同时设有技职学院（TAFE）的大学之一. 斯威本科技大学的研究产出许多商业公司 及年度校际盛事为《创业 杯》比赛. 斯威本科技大学的教学特色为新加坡人力部 认可的工作综合学习(Work Integrated Learning)导向的学习成果. 斯威本科技大学表现优异的设计学院 的学生，及商学院 的创业及创新硕士班的学生，和职场治疗专业的学生，可以申请亲自前往参加联盟校美国史丹佛大学的ME310-SUGAR的矽谷的产品开发课程 ，以及瑞士日内瓦的欧洲核子研究组织的IdeaSquare的知识转移的商品开发课程. 斯威本科技大学的微光子学研究具有国际顶尖的水准， 同时也是电机电子工程师学会的学生支部的会员. 斯威本科技大学累积的学术背景 所培养的博士生是全球少数参加过计算机协会人工智慧联盟的大学， 并且和联邦科学与工业研究组织 合作，是第一个在美国矽谷成立代表处的澳洲大学. 斯威本科技大学的学术评定方式是采用接近英国学术研究导向的严格的合格与否的制度， 著名的研究成果于杂志定期线上发表， 另外斯威本大学的科研应用事例也定期予以发表.
乔治·斯文本在1908年于东郊的技术学院的基础上，建立了斯威本科技大学的前身──斯威本学院. 1913年，这位有显著名望的的人将学校更改名称为斯威本科技学院.
在1976年至1978年期间，维多利亚州政府变革了学位体制，斯威本科技大学奉-{准}-授予学士学位课程，遂于1981年起正式颁发学士学位：于1982年-{升}-格为以理工为主的综合型大学. 于1992年，斯威本科技大学正式建立成为一所综合大学.
斯威本科技大学在墨尔本有4个主要校区，另外在马来西亚砂拉越设置一所国际分校. 斯威本科技大学的发展在澳大利亚教育界趋于独立，因为校方趋于与欧洲大学交流和合作，近年来斯威本科技大学也积极地投入 革新教育方式 及与澳洲本地 和其他国际知名大学的合作案中.
法庭心理学研究学者 Stephane Michel Shepherd 于2015-2016学季为傅尔布莱特计划奖学金得主.
en: The Swinburne University of Technology (or simply Swinburne) is a public research university in Melbourne, Australia. It is the modern descendant of the Eastern Suburbs Technical College established in 1908, renamed Swinburne Technical College in 1913 after its co-founders George and Ethel Swinburne. It has three campuses in metropolitan Melbourne: Hawthorn, where its main campus is located; Wantirna; and Croydon, as well the Swinburne University of Technology Sarawak Campus in the East Malaysian state of Sarawak. It also offers courses online and through its partnered institutions in Australia and overseas.

The university offers study programs in commerce, healthcare, teacher education, law, engineering, aviation, architecture, the performing arts and various other fields including in the arts and sciences. It also offers Doctor of Philosophy (PhD) research programs and courses in vocational education.

The university began in 1908 as the community-owned Eastern Suburbs Technical College on John Street, Hawthorn, to provide further education to residents of Melbourne's eastern suburbs. George Swinburne MLA, with the backing of Premier Thomas Bent, was the driving force behind its establishment, and its most generous benefactor, hence the name of the university. By 1913, £10,111 had been spent on its establishment, of which £3,718 came from private donations (including £1,000 each from George and Ethel Swinburne), and the remainder from the government. The first director was the sculptor J. R. Tranthim-Fryer, who remained in the position until 1938.

In 1913 the institution was taken over by the State Government, and its name changed to Swinburne Technical College. It later became known as the Swinburne Institute of Technical and Further Education (TAFE), eventually shortened to Swinburne Institute of Technology.

In the late 1980s, the Outer Eastern University Planning Council advocated for a new university to be established in outer eastern Melbourne. The area had the second lowest university participation rate in Melbourne, after the Mornington Peninsula. Partially in response to this advocacy, in 1990 Swinburne established its "Eastern Campus" in Mooroolbark (sometimes described as Lilydale), on the site of the recently closed MDA Grammar School. However, students could not attend until 1992 due to council planning negotiation, and the campus was officially opened on 6 April 1992. By 1993, it was known as the "Mooroolbark Campus".
